adds.title: Law No. 18,634 - State Policy for Combating Violence against LGBTQIA+ People, Legislative Assembly of Pernambuco
adds.summary: On 4 July 2024 Pernambuco instituted the State Policy for Combating Violence against LGBTQIA+ People to confront discrimination and violence based on gender identity, sexual orientation and sex characteristics and promote full citizenship, with objectives to monitor violence data with compiled methodology, strengthen and implement protection, promotion and defense services and reception for those in vulnerability and social risk, build a governmental and non-governmental response network, and expand protection statewide, recognizing such identity-based violence as structural, historical and incompatible with democratic rule and human rights and requiring consideration of intersecting race, territory, class, gender, age, religion and disability vulnerabilities, to be implemented transversally through reception-service guidelines, emergency support to civil-society services respecting individual liberty and citizenship, and government reception policies focused on assistance, health, citizenship, culture, public security and justice including mapping and training of public and civil-society reception facilities, data collection and knowledge production with research bodies and universities, partnerships with municipalities and public-private entities, and support for aligned civil-society initiatives, prioritizing victims of identity-based violence/discrimination, those with actual or imminent rupture of family/community ties, and those with compounded vulnerabilities, with regulation by the Executive and entry into force on publication.

adds.title: Supreme Federal Court of Brazil ruling of 1 March 2018 on gender identity
adds.summary: On 1 March 2018 in ADI 4275 the Brazilian Supreme Federal Court, applicable in Pernambuco, held that the right to equality without discrimination encompasses gender identity and expression and authorized alteration of name and gender in the civil registry without sex-reassignment surgery or judicial authorization, on the basis that gender identity is a manifestation of personality that the State must recognize.

adds.title: Court of Justice of Pernambuco 2023 ruling authorizing Tarlazza Messina document change
adds.summary: In 2023 in Pernambuco the judiciary for the first time recognized non-binary gender and authorized rectification of Tarlazza Messina's birth certificate to register gender as 'não binárie'.

adds.title: Supreme Federal Court decision of 2019 prohibiting discrimination based on sexual orientation and gender identity
adds.summary: On 24 May 2019 a majority of Brazil's Supreme Federal Court (6 of 11 justices) voted to treat transphobia and homophobia as crimes equivalent to racism, punishable under Brazil's racism law until Congress adopts specific LGBT-protection legislation.

adds.title: Municipal law of Garanhuns signed 13 December 2017 by mayor Izaías Régis prohibiting 'gender ideology' in schools
adds.summary: On 13 December 2017 Garanhuns, Pernambuco enacted Municipal Law No. 4432/2017 prohibiting direct or indirect discussion and pedagogical including extracurricular activities on gender theory, questions, identity or ideology in municipal schools effective upon publication after 11-to-1 council approval despite a late-November 2017 state prosecution recommendation to reject it as reinforcing stereotypes and prejudice against those not conforming to dominant standards.
